limitations: Leading high-noise, fixed-budget asymptotics only. No finite-contrast exact optimizer uniqueness, adaptive-query result, arbitrary prior/channel extension or growing-budget uniformity. Historical priority not independently certified.
scientific_scope: For each fixed integer number of at least three nonadaptive parallel upper-threshold queries under a uniform prior, independent identically reliable binary-symmetric responses and squared-error posterior-mean decoding; limit p increases to one half.
title: Universal high-noise staircase for optimal parallel threshold localization
